evidence_items.claim: Koichiro Funayama (MD, Head of Derivatives Business Strategy, MUMSS) joined ISDA Board in May 2025
evidence_items.excerpt: Funayama took on his current role in May 2025, having previously served as Head of Derivatives Trading Office. He joined MUFG Bank in 2001.

evidence_items.claim: MUFG is NOT a FINOS member - not listed on FINOS members page
evidence_items.excerpt: MUFG, Mitsubishi UFJ, or any MUFG subsidiary is not listed among FINOS Platinum, Gold, Silver, or Associate members.

evidence_items.claim: MUFG operates Progmat digital securities platform for tokenized securities and stablecoins
evidence_items.excerpt: MUFG initially developed Progmat as an enterprise blockchain network for tokenized securities, including bonds, equities, and other digital assets.

evidence_items.claim: MUFG is Japan's largest bank with active derivatives operations (Risk.net coverage)
evidence_items.excerpt: MUFG lowered credit and CCR charges the most among Japan's top dealers. MUFG's derivatives portfolio consists of interest rate and FX transactions.

evidence_items.claim: MUFG subject to JFSA derivatives reporting requirements (April 2024 rewrite)
evidence_items.excerpt: Japan Financial Services Agency (JFSA) reporting regulation went into effect April 1, 2024 with ISO 20022 messaging and 139 reporting fields.

null_results.actual_result: MUFG is NOT a FINOS member. No CDM contribution found.
No evidence. Digital focus is on Progmat (security tokens), not CDM.
No evidence of ISDA DRR adoption despite ISDA Board presence.
